records.context: The adjustments are best-effort and platform dependent. On Linux, the worker uses the lowest CPU and I/O priorities and sets ``oom_score_adj=800`` so it is preferred over interactive applications when the system is under memory pressure. On Windows, which has none of those, the worker drops to the idle priority class.

records.source: The adjustments are best-effort and platform dependent. On Linux, the worker uses the lowest CPU and I/O priorities and sets ``oom_score_adj=800`` so it is preferred over interactive applications when the system is under memory pressure. On Windows, which has none of those, the worker drops to the idle priority class.
records.translation: Aðlaganirnar eru gerðar eftir bestu getu og ráðast af stýrikerfinu. Á Linux notar vinnsluferlið lægsta forgang fyrir CPU og I/O og stillir ``oom_score_adj=800`` þannig að það sé valið á undan gagnvirkum forritum þegar minni kerfisins þrýtur. Á Windows, sem býður ekkert af þessu, færist vinnsluferlið í forgangsflokk aðgerðaleysis.
